text:
devops-priya: Hey team — starting ~02:10Z after the OS kernel + openssl security patch, our onprem HSM nodes (model: SafeChip-X5) have intermittent CSR signing failures for the TLS signing key (slot 2). A bunch of customer cert issuance requests are failing with 502s from our signing service.

support-jordan: Can you paste the error stub from the signing service?

devops-priya: Logs from the signer: 
```
2026-03-16T02:12:31Z signer[2145]: sign_request id=abcd1234 slot=2 key=prod-tls error=CKR_FUNCTION_FAILED
2026-03-16T02:12:31Z signer[2145]: hsm_rpc: write timeout after 5000ms
2026-03-16T02:12:31Z signer[2145]: fallback to software signing
```

sre-lee: HSM oncall-bot shows a brief connection spike to the KMS connector around 02:11Z — see bot: 
`hsm-oncall-bot: node-03: session_count=128 -> 1024 (PM spike) health=degraded for ~40s`

devops-priya: We also see intermittent `CKR_SESSION_HANDLE_INVALID` in some traces (rare). Audit logs from the HSM side are weird: there are no audit entries for the failed operations in the HSM audit stream between 02:10–02:15Z for this key id.

support-jordan: Does the keystore (our app-level keystore) still show the key metadata as present? Any mismatch between key slot and label?

devops-priya: Keystore lists key label `prod/tls-2024` -> slot 2, keyid matches. HSM key slot appears present per `pkcs11-list` output. No deletion events.

eng-crypto-ana: Quick questions:
- Did the HSM firmware change recently?
- Any load tests or batch job that would cause KV/cache thrash?
- Are all nodes in the cluster showing the issue or only node-03?

devops-priya: No firmware change. The kernel + openssl security patch was rolled to the host OS fleet at 02:05Z (deploy-bot message). Only signer hosts that route to node-03 HSM instance seeing most errors; node-01/node-02 fine.

hsm-oncall-bot: deploy-bot: linux-5.15.83 applied to signer-hosts at 02:05Z. HSM firmware stable at v4.1.2.

eng-crypto-ana: Can you capture a failed RPC exchange and include the base64 dump? Also get `pkcs11-tool --list-objects --slot 2 -v` from the host and the HSM system log `/var/log/hsm/daemon.log` for 02:08–02:20Z.

devops-priya: Attaching short extracts: 
```
pkcs11-tool output (host):
  Objects: 1
  Label: prod/tls-2024
  Type: Private Key

/var/log/hsm/daemon.log (excerpt):
  02:11:27.412 | rpc: recv len=122 -> parse ok
  02:11:27.413 | crypto: sign start slot=2
  02:11:27.417 | crypto: sign error CKR_FUNCTION_FAILED (0x5)
  02:11:27.417 | audit: not writing audit entry for unknown reason
```

security-csm: The "audit: not writing audit entry" is alarming from a compliance side. We need to preserve evidence for customers whose cert issuance failed — open a secure collection for logs and freeze retention.

support-jordan: Agreed. Priya — please run `tcpdump -w /tmp/hsm_rpc_fail.pcap port 2222` while reproducing so crypto can see packet-level failures. Also enable debug on the HSM daemon: `/etc/hsm/daemon.conf` set `log_level=debug` and rotate after capturing.

devops-priya: Running now. I can repro by curling our issuance endpoint with `X-Request-Id` header; about 1 in 5 requests fail with the same sign error. Captured pcap and debug logs at `/tmp/escalation-1976543210/` and uploaded to the secure bucket (link: https://redwood-secure.internal/s/esc-1976543210).

eng-crypto-ana: Thanks. Two hypotheses: (1) OS patch changed io/ucontext timings causing HSM library timeouts; (2) signer process concurrency is exhausting HSM session limits and HSM is returning CKR_FUNCTION_FAILED rather than a clearer overflow code. We'll test increasing `hsm.max_sessions` and bump rpc timeout to 10s as an immediate mitigation.

sre-lee: Also check for a combined power/interrupt/PCI reset in the host dmesg around 02:10 — I saw unrelated kernel messages in other clusters when patch applied.

devops-priya: dmesg for signer-host shows: `pci 0000:3b:00.0: reset_pipeline() called` at 02:09:59 — I can include full dmesg.

security-csm: Meanwhile, open a compliance incident ticket — note potential audit gap (02:10–02:15Z) for keys used in customer cert issuance. We need to notify impacted enterprise customers per our data-retention playbook only after eng confirms root cause.

support-jordan: For short-term customer mitigation: enable software fallback with rate limit (we already have auto-fallback but it spawns more software signs than usual). Suggest increasing throttle to avoid overloading downstream. Also schedule a rolling restart of signer-hosts one-at-a-time after increasing `hsm.rpc_timeout_ms` and `hsm.max_sessions`.

eng-crypto-ana: I'll reproduce in staging by replaying the pcap and toggling kernel ABI flags. If we can trigger same `CKR_FUNCTION_FAILED` in staging with same kernel, we can confirm host-side cause. If not, escalate to HSM vendor with the pcap and daemon logs (they requested base64 of the RPC frames).

devops-priya: Uploaded base64 RPC frame: `bG9nOjEyMzQtcmVxb3...` to the secure link. Also started increasing `hsm.rpc_timeout_ms` to 10000 and `hsm.max_sessions` from 512->2048 on node-03. Will monitor.

sre-lee: Keep me posted. If this repeats after increasing sessions/timeouts, we should prepare a failover plan to route signing to a healthy HSM cluster (or CloudHSM) to reduce customer impact.

eng-crypto-ana: Noted. I tagged vendor support (cc: @vendor-hsm) in the support ticket with logs.

hsm-oncall-bot: vendor-ticket created: VND-98765, severity=high.

support-jordan: Good. Security — please hold off on customer-wide emails until we have either (a) confirmed host-side patch issue and mitigation or (b) HSM vendor confirms hardware/firmware fault.

security-csm: Acknowledged. I'll prepare a skeleton notification and watch for status updates here.

devops-priya: After config changes, error rate dropped from ~20% -> ~1% in the next 15m. Still seeing occasional `CKR_SESSION_HANDLE_INVALID`. Logs show sessions being recycled during peak concurrency.

eng-crypto-ana: That drop points to session exhaustion combined with tighter RPC timing after kernel patch. We'll keep the increased session cap and vendor will investigate whether the HSM daemon should return clearer overflow codes. For now leave `hsm.rpc_timeout_ms=10000` and monitor for 24h.

support-jordan: Closing action items for this thread:
- Priya: keep debug logs until 2026-03-18T02:00Z and upload rotated logs.
- Ana: reproduce in staging and coordinate with vendor.
- Security: hold notification template.
- SRE: prepare failover runbook to route to CloudHSM if needed.

devops-priya: Will do. Thanks all. :thumbsup:

sre-lee: Marking follow-up check in 6 hours. :alarm_clock:
